about: Listening and finished-mix evidence for catalog assets. EMPTY on purpose: no catalog track has been auditioned, so there is no auditioned or approved_in_finished_mix entry and every catalog row stays metadata_reviewed with listened:false. A row may claim `listened:true` or a higher evidence_state only when an entry below matches the row's asset id AND version. Repeated filenames are not evidence. Read by scripts/lib/catalog-evidence.mjs (evidenceFor, validateEvidenceEntry); nothing writes this file in code yet, entries are added by a person or by an approved listening step.

entry_shape.asset_id: catalog track id (e.g. fma-ketsa-flushed) or sfx id
entry_shape.version: which bytes were judged: the row's sha256 (preferred) or a catalog version label. An entry for another version is stale, never proof.
entry_shape.reviewer: who: a person's name or id, or the model id for a model-assisted review
entry_shape.method: listened_full | listened_sections | listened_in_context (required for auditioned and above); measured_only and tagged are metadata, they cannot raise the state

context.purpose: what the listening was for (e.g. speech-friendly bed, shortlist audition)
context.film: project or run id (required for approved_in_finished_mix)
context.mix_receipt: mix-receipt id or digest of the finished mix it was judged in (required for approved_in_finished_mix)
context.section: optional: the part of the track heard, in seconds

rules: metadata_reviewed < auditioned < approved_in_finished_mix; the rank never counts as a score.
stems.verified:true on a catalog row also needs an entry here for that version.
Do not backfill entries from tags, measurements or earlier runs; an unlistened asset stays unlistened.
